title: The Upload button says why it is disabled
summary: The Upload screen names, beside a disabled Upload to the installation, the lock that disables it: the installation not answering, the destination being checked, an upload or a deletion under way; the destination line blames the card only after a reply said it is absent, a failed request keeps the last capacity and moves the form nowhere, and Internal is never disabled for the card. App only: no command and no firmware change.
